title: The Secret to Your First Claude Chat
description: How to have your first conversation with Claude, and the follow-up trick most beginners miss. Follow for a new AI lesson every day. Not affiliated with Anthropic. #ai #claude #learnai #aitips #shorts

scenes.narration: Most people use AI wrong in their very first chat. Here's the secret.
Type a question, just like you'd ask a person. Let's try: explain compound interest like I'm twelve.

visual.title: Ask anything
items: Imagine you plant one apple tree. Every year it grows apples, and some of those apples grow into new trees. Your money works the same way: it earns money, and that money earns even more.

scenes.narration: Here's the secret most beginners miss. It's a conversation. You don't have to get it perfect the first time. Just keep talking.
Ask it to make the answer shorter, add an example, or change the tone. Claude remembers what you said earlier in the same chat.

visual.title: Keep refining
items: Now show me a real example with $100
Sure. Save $100 at 5% a year and after one year you have $105. The next year you earn 5% on $105, so you have $110.25, and it keeps growing.

scenes.narration: And if an answer misses the mark, you can edit your message, ask Claude to try again, or simply add more detail.
